title: Commander Deck Diagnostic | Personalised Written Review
thesis: Your Commander deck looks good on paper, but is it doing what you built it to do?
body: A focused written review covering mana base, curve, draw, ramp, interaction, win conditions, weak links and prioritised improvements. After your Patreon Shop purchase, send a public Moxfield or Archidekt decklist through Patreon messages. This is a custom manual report, not a live call or an instant download.

product.delivery_terms: Report delivered through Patreon messages within 24 hours after receipt of a complete accessible decklist. If unable to fulfil, arrange an appropriate remedy or refund.
